blockdesc-saptap-*:
Hammered into a log that is oozing resin. Hang a bucket from the hook to catch the sap.
Made from a metal plate or a metal sheet, worked with a hammer AND chisel at least as hard as the metal itself: bronze tools for copper, bronze and the other soft metals, iron or meteoric iron tools for iron, steel tools for steel. Copper tools are too soft for any of it.
error-requiresresinlog: Sap taps only go into a log that is oozing resin.
error-treehasmaxtaps: This tree already carries the maximum of {0} sap taps.
error-noroom: There is no room in front of the log for a sap tap.
error-notabucket: Only an empty bucket can be hung on a sap tap.
error-bucketnotempty: Empty the bucket before hanging it on a sap tap.
message-collected: Collected {0} resin from the sap tap.
message-notfullyet: The bucket is not full yet: {0:0.#} / {1} litres.
